steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: No, you don't understand. If this goes on...

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: I-I could very well find myself killed!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Have you tried the cops?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: *sigh* Of course I have. They said I'm just overthinking it. I asked around and someone told me about you guys. You're a detective agency, right? Figuring out who wants to kill me and making sure I'm safe should be right up your alley!

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Besides, I'm pretty sure... the L.G.D. are actually working with those guys.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: That's gotta be why they're ignoring me!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Oh? The L.G.D.'s in on it, you say?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Alright, interesting. We'll take the case!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Normally, we charge a thousand LMD per billable hour, but I'll give you a discount. 30 thousand for the whole job. How's that?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Wait, slow down there, Aak.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: (Whispers) Look, I'm sick of eating nothing but cup noodles every single day. Which of the gigs you picked up lately even got us paid, anyway? At this rate, we'll be dead before Lee's back.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: And please calm down a little, Mr... uh...
Hung looks down at the business card he got from the man earlier. He works for a famous corporation in Lungmen, with a fairly impressive title next to his name to boot.
Hung thinks to himself, the client probably has much more lavish meals than cup noodles every day.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Mr. Lau.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: You said earlier that you think you're being followed. Are you sure you are not imagining things?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: For example, a few days ago I was at the wet markets picking up groceries, and I was certain someone was following me... until I realized it was just a cloudbeast cub.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: I'm telling you, it's not like that! Look...
Mr. Lau cautiously looks around.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Lately, there've been all these strange marks on the walls outside my front door. I looked it up on the intercity net! They all say it means somebody's out to get me!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: And I actually felt some strange glances! Both during my commute and even at the office! It always feels like there's somebody observing me.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Ugh... Just thinking about it gives me chills.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Look, maybe it's just a stray cloudbeast...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Why would there be a stray cloudbeast in an office building?!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: And scariest of all is that I keep hearing someone whispering at night...

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Mr. Lau, at the end of the street, you'll find a store that sells essential oils. There's this oil with a calming effect that I've tried out. It really helps give you sleep better.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Maybe you're just a little tense lately. Try massaging yourself with some of that oil. It'll calm you down.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: *sigh* Not you too...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: But you know, it does sound like somebody might be following him.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: You don't just constantly feel like somebody's watching you for no reason.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: And speaking from experience, if you can notice them at all, it just shows how fearless they are. They aren't afraid of being seen, much less what you'd do after you find out.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Right?!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Hey now, stop scaring the client. This is nothing like that. Your situation's... a lot more unique.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: By the way, Mr. Lau, are the marks still there?

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Yeah, you bet they are! I wiped them off once, but then they showed up again, and I didn't dare wipe them off again... On top of that, they keep multiplying every few days.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Then let's go have a look right now.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Now?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: When else? If I were the mastermind behind this, I'd definitely be watching him in the dead of night.
Hung looks at the time displayed on his terminal and scratches his head.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: We don't even know if there's actually a mastermind per se...

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: But alright. Mr. Lau, would you mind if we go have a look now? Maybe it could offer you some peace of mind.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: N-Not at all!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hold up, let me bring my camera!
As the sparse traffic speeds down the road, the streetlights lining the sidewalks light up one after another. Mr. Lau is walking in front of the two investigators, looking back from time to time.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: What? You think someone's following you again?

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: I don't feel them now. Weird... I was sure somebody was watching me on my way to your office...

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Maybe you're just a little too nervous. The old man at the canteen downstairs loves to watch people come and go when he's got nothing to do. He probably just thought you looked a little strange.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: I-Is that so...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, here we are. My flat is here, up on the second floor.
Mr. Lau's home is in an old shopping district. The mottled coating on the outer wall is starting to peel off, and there is a damp stench in the staircase.

Fearfully, he points at the walls by his front door. There are indeed multiple strange marks. One is particularly evident, with three more slender traces criss-crossing each other and leading toward the door.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Look, right here! I wiped them off before, then a couple days later, they showed up again. The same pattern, too. Always the same pattern...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: The spacing's consistent, but the depth's different... Doesn't look manmade—

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Is it a ghost, then?!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: More like they were made by machines.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Mr. Lau, whoever's behind this, looks like they brought a machine to spook you.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Wh-What...
Hung crouches down and observes the wall. He lightly touches the dust on the ground and rubs it between his fingers, revealing a faint light-blue gleam.
Aak starts to take pictures of the wall, as Hung turns around toward the staircase.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: It's a false alarm, Mr. Lau. This wasn't drawn deliberately. The faint light-blue powder here is just dried soap.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: And considering the pattern in the spacing... this is probably from a cleaning robot.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: How can you be so sure?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: There are tread marks. Look.
Aak and Mr. Lau look toward where Hung is pointing, and see faint tread marks on the floor beneath the marks on the wall.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Uh, you sure? Maybe the culprit rode one of those little scooters here to mark his walls.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: H-Huh?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: It's okay, Mr. Lau. The marks are likely just a misunderstanding. Now how about we figure out what the whispers you heard at night were? Do you mind if we go inside?

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: P-Please, by all means!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: (Whispers) But I heard somebody running away when I opened the door yesterday... Was that the janitor?
The night is deep. Mr. Lau's home is lit by only a few small lights. Through the window blinds, the red light of the neon signs outside can be seen flashing.
Hung stays at the door to check if there is any moment outside as Aak looks out the window, pointing a flashlight at the building across the street and occasionally taking pictures with his camera.

Meanwhile, Mr. Lau has wrapped himself up in a blanket, with a flashlight clenched tightly in his hand. The only thing that can be heard inside the room is the faint sound of the breeze, interrupted intermittently by the shutter of Aak's camera.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Doesn't look like anyone passed outside. I can just barely hear cars speeding past and nothing else. Aak, what are you looking at over there?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: You know, the folks in this neighborhood all seem pretty nice. There's even somebody downstairs feeding a stray cloudbeast at this hour.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Say, do you think anyone'd come feed us if we went downstairs and lied down on the ground at night?

spans.text: Say, do you think anyone'd come feed
if we went downstairs and lied down on the ground at night?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Looks like he's done feeding it. The cloudbeast cub is coming this way now... Oh, look at it hop. What a lively one.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Let me take a picture...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: No, that can't be a stray. Look, it's got a collar.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, that's Siumi. Probably a pet that got lost. You can always find someone feeding it these days.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: It's pretty friendly, too. Every night, it comes up to my window for a walk. Wait, why are we talking about cloudbeasts?

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Just wait a little longer. Every night around this time, you can hear these strange whispers coming from the wall...
Bzz—zzz—
Right after he finishes his sentence, the room falls silent for a brief moment, before the gang actually hears a strange noise.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Th-That's the sound!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: It sounds like some kinda current to me...

Mr. Lau is so anxious that he begins to sweat. Aak finds himself bewildered, too. On the other hand, Hung's usual cool composure remains unchanged. He stands up slowly, and presses his ear against the wall for a few seconds. Then, he heads toward the kitchen.
After a few minutes, the sound dissipates.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Huh? The sound of the current stopped. What did you just do?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: That was the air purifier. There was something stuck inside, and I pulled it out.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: The fan's a little loose, and it got stuck inside the machine when it was turning. That's why it was making all that noise. Maybe it only sounded like voices because it's in the other room.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: That's it? What was stuck inside anyway?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Looks like some kind of component.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: It's been some time since I used it, actually. But since the air quality in town's been pretty bad lately, I've been keeping it on to at least get some fresher air inside the place, and it hasn't been turned off the entire time. Never thought something could be stuck inside...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, maybe it fell inside when that plumber came to fix the pipes last week? I knew it... The plumbers on the intercity net are all unreliable... That's what I get for being cheap.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: This part...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: *sigh* Good thing I had you two come check this out for me. If it weren't for you, I probably wouldn't be able to live here anymore.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: You're just too on edge. Calm down. Lungmen isn't full of conspiracies, and there's no such thing as ghosts.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: You've been imagining things because of all these strange marks and sounds, and I can sympathize with that, but you seem overly nervous. I hope you don't mind me asking, but did something happen recently?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: If you ask me, given that you think someone's been following you, and that you're even worried about threats to your life... there has to be something more than the marks on the wall and the air purifier's sounds that got you so worried in the first place.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I actually... reported a coworker from my company last week... for smuggling and embezzlement.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: I've always known that the company deals in some pretty shady business, and that coworker of mine keeps getting promoted pretty quickly, so I suspected him... No, I guess I just envied him...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: But I got so hotheaded that I went and reported him! Ever since, I've been scared he'll come and get me.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: And I haven't seen him in the office all week, either... Maybe... Maybe he's making preparations to off me.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Why didn't you tell us sooner?!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Misunderstandings between people ought to be resolved as soon as possible. Otherwise, they'll start piling up, and things are bound to get out of hand from there.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: It's pretty late already, so we'll head back for the day. Calm down. Everything will be resolved by the time you visit our office tomorrow.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, thank you so much, you two! As for your payment—

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We'll talk about that tomorrow. Try to get some rest now.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Interesting. Someone's out to get revenge, huh?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: And how can you be so sure that you'll have this taken care of by tomorrow?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Well, it's just a little misunderstanding. I can handle that.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Once we get paid tomorrow, we'll finally be able to get ourselves some fresh vegetables. Stir-fried meat with corn, braised ribs with pumpkin, and how about some cucumber salad with cloud ears? Anything you want to eat, Aak?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Come on, I'm just asking you to come up with a dish for dinner tomorrow. No need to look all serious.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: You know, I'm really not sure about this. There's no way that Siumi just so happens to take leisurely walks on his windowsill every single night, and there just so happen to be strange sounds that start as soon as it makes its way up.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Check out the tag on its collar! It glows! Look, I got a picture here. Just think about it. Why would anyone give a cloudbeast that kinda bling? This is way, waaay too shady.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Maybe that's just what's trendy these days. Having a glowing collar helps those who comes feed it at night, too. Look at how dark its fur is. You gotta look really carefully to even spot it.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: A dark-furred cloudbeast with a glowing collar and a fixed routine... Someone feeds it every night... Strange marks, strange sounds, and a component stuck inside the guy's air purifier...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hah, what did I just say? I found the guy who's been tailing Mr. Lau!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Take a look at the picture. That guy downstairs is holding something in his hand, looking up!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: He's probably just looking at Siumi.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: But Siumi's hanging out on Mr. Lau's windowsill?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Which means... that guy downstairs is using Siumi to eavesdrop on, no, to monitor Mr. Lau! That flashy collar? That might just be a camera!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Good thing you didn't mention this theory in Mr. Lau's place. He'd be scared out of his wits.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Did you see the bags under his eyes? He probably hasn't had a good night's sleep for a week. At this rate, he'll end up with neurasthenia.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Life in Lungmen's not really all that hard. I mean, Lee often gets himself dragged into some pretty hot messes... and there are things you can't talk over.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: But the way I see it, if everyone just treated each other with sincerity and respect right from the start, things wouldn't be nearly as troublesome. If it's all a misunderstanding, then there's still room to talk things out, and it's always worth a shot.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: After all, all this boils down to interpersonal problems. You don't like me, I don't like you. You envy me, I envy you back. It's a vicious cycle.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: In any case, once we take care of the problem at its source tomorrow, Mr. Lau's worries will be a thing of the past.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Not every day we actually agree with each other...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Yeah, let's take care of the problem at its source. Heh, tomorrow, I'm gonna hit up the mastermind's crib and see exactly what it is they're up to.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Crib? What crib?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Phew… Let's head on home already. Gotta get up early tomorrow for work.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Where's Aak? I thought we were going to take care of this problem first thing in the morning.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Eh, whatever. I can probably handle this alone. I should be able to keep up appearances by myself.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Hello? Oh, Mr. Lau. I'm at the store.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Thanks for doing all of this. I'm almost done picking out everything I'll need.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Oh, right... Would it be okay if we got a small advance payment?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, hey... Siumi, come on out.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: You see this piece of meat? It's from my cup noodles this morning. If you want it, you gotta give me something in exchange—

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hah, just as I thought. There's a camera on the collar's tag.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: That's way too roundabout for gangs these days, using stray animals... If not them, then maybe some corporation? Or maybe it's a personal grudge thing?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Mr. Lau said he offended somebody... Maybe this is—

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hold up, is that the guy who was feeding Siumi downstairs last night? He's knocking on Mr. Lau's door.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Nobody's here. Hm, guess Hung stopped by and lured him away. Good one.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: He's talking to somebody... Oh, is he leaving already? Not good. Gotta follow him. He might be trying to look for Mr. Lau.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, outta the way, Siumi! I'm all outta meat!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Phew... He sure runs quick...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: The shopping district? Shit, maybe he noticed I've been tailing him. It's the weekend. There's way too many people here! This isn't gonna be easy...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Huh? Is that... Hung and Mr. Lau? Why are they both holding all those bags? Those aren't their weapons or whatever, right?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Agh, what to do... Should I call the cops? But what if the L.G.D. takes Hung away too?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Whatever... Following that guy's more important.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, coming through! Make way!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: A residential building? That's pretty spartan for a crib...

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Now he's got a huge bag in his hand. Most likely handed to him by one of his buddies from the shopping street... What's inside... Weapons? Stolen cash?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Argh, should I get in touch with Hung or call the cops first? He looks pretty thin, though. Bet Hung could take him down no problem.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Wait... Is he looking at me? Crap! He noticed me!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Ahhh!!! He's coming this way! And his hand is in the bag—

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Uh, oh my, Wong... What happened to you?

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: Well, haha... I had a little fall last week and ended up in the hospital.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Goodness... That's pretty serious... Uh...
Mr. Lau and Mr. Wong simply look at each other quietly in embarrassment, as though the air in the staircase has frozen over.
Next to them, with a bright smile on his face and two plastic bags full of fruits in his hands, Hung looks toward Mr. Lau with expectant eyes.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: (Whispering) You asked me where the coworker I reported lives, and this is why?!

spans.text: (Whispering) You asked me where the coworker I reported lives, and

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: (Whispering) Yeah!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: (Whispering) You... You could've at least told me and let me prepare myself, mentally!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: (Whispering) What? Didn't I say last night that misunderstandings between people ought to be resolved as soon as possible?

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: (Whispering) I didn't know you meant this—

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: May I ask what you two are here for? If you don't need anything, I'll head inside now.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Hold on, Mr. Wong! Mr. Lau has something important to tell you!

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: It's really, really important!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: (Whispering) Go on, Mr. Lau! We're here already. Might as well!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: (Whispering) A-Alright...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Well, uh, remember how I got a little hotheaded last week and reported you? You see, for the last six months, work hasn't been going very smoothly, but you got promoted so easily... and I got a little jealous.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: I really should've talked to you about this ahead of time! I mean, the company dealing in shady business doesn't have anything to do with me personally. I didn't have to stick my nose into this...

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: So, what I'm saying is, I'm here to apologize today, Wong. Please, take these!
Lau finishes getting everything off his chest, and hands the two big bags of fruit to Wong.

Wong's mouth is half agape, as though he just heard the most shocking news of the century. He already has one hand busy holding a crutch, and is unsure how to take the two bags of fruit with his free hand.
Hung takes Mr. Wong's free hand, and pulls it toward Mr. Lau's hand. At the same time, he also hands the fruit directly to Mr. Wong.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: That's the gist of it. For the past week, my client has been losing sleep over this, thinking he had acted too rashly. That's why he's here to apologize.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: As they say, friendship is wealth! Let's not dwell over matters past.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: What do you say, Mr. Wong?

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: You're far too kind, Lau... I actually didn't even know the company was dealing in gray area business. I was just doing what the higher-ups told me to, and had no idea what they were up to.

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: The company reassigned me to another department, and truth be told, you were a lifesaver. If you hadn't reported that in time, the company might've set me up as a fall guy!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, so that's why!

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Oh, this is all my fault! If I'd only talked to you about this back then...

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: No, no, no. Don't say that, Lau.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Great, that takes care of everything. In the end, nothing's more important than actually talking to each other.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Now you don't need to worry about getting followed anymore, Mr. Lau!

steps.name: Mr. Wong
steps.text: Followed...?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Right, now that the misunderstanding between you has been cleared, to celebrate, how would you two like to come to my place for a meal?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Uh, hold on...
Before the two of them could answer, Hung suddenly shakes his head. Then, he clasps his hands.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Let's head out for a meal. I know a pretty decent place. What do you two think? It's a little early for lunch, so if we head there now, there likely won't be much of a wait.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Oh right, Mr. Lau, I may need a little advance payment after all.

steps.name: Mr. Lau
steps.text: Haha, not a problem! I'm hungry too. Come on, we'll call a taxi. This meal's on me!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Gragh, how could this all just be a misunderstanding?! What a freaking letdown.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Can you believe it? I tailed that guy for the better part of the day, and it turns out he was a part-time water fitness salesman!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: I asked him what kind of business he had with Mr. Lau, and you know what he said?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: *cough* 'Lau promised me to come to the pool to try out our fitness program, but he never picked up when I called, nor did he answer when I knocked on his door. What the hell?'

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: What the hell?' I could've asked him the same thing!

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Calm down. It's nighttime already. Why are you still mad about that? What's wrong with it all being a misunderstanding?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: When Mr. Lau left, he even told me that now that he's talked to Mr. Wong, he didn't feel like he was being followed anymore. He even bought the essential oil I recommended. I'm sure he'll have a good night's sleep tonight.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: And I feel kinda bad about this. We didn't really do much, but he paid us such a huge sum of money.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, I put a lot of work into this case... I mean, I approached it in the wrong direction, but still.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Weird, though... If this was all a misunderstanding, then what was up with those sneaky guys whispering to the part-timer dude?

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Maybe they were just going about their business.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: I mean, most folks in this city are still law-abiding citizens going about their normal, everyday lives.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: And come on, don't just eat the meat. The veggies and shrooms are all fresh, too. The braised bamboo shoots aren't bad either. Give 'em a try.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: You're way too optimistic about people, you know?! Yeah, things turned out fine this time, but what if the next time you bring the client to a meeting a hundred mafia hitmen come running out?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: At least Lee has a bunch of tricks up his sleeve, and I'd be more worried about anyone he flimflams. But you? You trust others way too easily!

spans.text: At least Lee has a bunch of tricks up his sleeve, and I'd be more worried about anyone
flimflams. But you? You trust others way too easily!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: I'm telling you, this client, no, that guy who tailed him, and that company! All of them have got some shady business going on, I know it!

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: *sigh* For real, what would you do without me? I really gotta keep an eye peeled and look out for the both of us.

steps.name: Hung
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I couldn't do it without you. Now eat.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Anyway, thanks for your cooperation.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We're here for a midnight snack, and you still want to talk work?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...Do the two of us even have anything to talk about but work?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That was a close one, though. Those guys were gonna settle the score today. If that 'concerned citizen' hadn't gone and apologized, he'd have died for sure.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They would've died.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The guy they apologized to is an informant of mine. He went straight home as soon as he was discharged from the hospital, not even realizing he was being watched.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: *sigh...* What a coincidence, then.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You call that a coincidence? If you ask me, that big fella from the detective agency may look like an honest guy, but he's actually pretty sharp. He even knew to bring his client to a place with lots of people around.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Gotta say, a certain somebody's really not handling these things up to snuff. I mean, there were terrorists hiding in the residential buildings. Can you believe it?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Well, I'd say a certain somebody should take better care that the personal information of her sources doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Mind your own business! I was just going to look into that!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're wide open.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Om nom nom)

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh?! That was the last finball! How dare you, you stinky rat—
